definitions.gloss: poor work; bad piece; flop; mediocre creation
definitions.explanation: A piece of art, writing, film, or other creative work that is considered to be of low quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{駄作|ださく}だった。
{名監督|めいかんとく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{駄作|ださく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even great directors have some bad works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期待|きたい}していた→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄作|ださく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧だった。
examples.english: I had high expectations, but it was terrible and a waste of time.

notes:
A blunt, critical term for a creative work of low quality — a dud, a flop, or a bad piece.

FORMS:
{駄|だ} (worthless, inferior) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, creation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駄作|ださく}{揃|ぞろ}い: nothing but bad works
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧{駄作|ださく}: a historically bad work
- {駄作|ださく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: bad works and masterpieces

APPLIES TO:
Films, novels, art, music, and other creative outputs. Used in reviews, criticism, and casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧: masterpiece (the strongest positive)
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: classic work, acclaimed work
- ⟦{佳作|かさく}→佳作：22658_kasaku⟧: good but not outstanding work
- ⟦{凡作|ぼんさく}→凡作：16300_bonsaku⟧: mediocre work (less harsh than {駄作|ださく})
